description: Mechanics-15 NL calibration: the full run's cell and model settings on ONE maze (M10, all four mechanics) to measure per-query input/output tokens and cost before launching run_config.mechanics_15_nl.json.
_note_no_conditions: No conditions key => single (default) cell built from experiment_config overlay. Do NOT add conditions (that would re-enable the sweep).
_note_requires: context_window=full comes from PR #54 (R2 full context). Launching before it is on the launched SHA fails at config load. NL history caching comes from PR #75 (one text block per history step); without it Claude and OpenAI cache only the system prompt and resend the whole history uncached every query.
_note_model_params: Equal 64k output caps (max_tokens; max_completion_tokens for OpenAI and Kimi K3). Thinking on for all three. Opus 5.5: effort=xhigh, no sampling params, Message Batches API via the lockstep worker (worker_role=lockstep-worker; coordinator STALE_AFTER_SECONDS >= 12600). Kimi K3: always thinks, reasoning_effort=max (Moonshot's default, set explicitly for provenance), no thinking object or sampling params; plain worker on the sync API (Moonshot Batch support for kimi-k3 unverified). GPT-6 Astra: reasoning_effort=xhigh, flex tier, image_detail=high, plain worker (the OpenAI agent has no batch path). Spend caps are set per model and per modality, unlike the equal output caps: spend_cap_usd is a hard stop on that model's priced usage in its worker process (interface/agents/spend_cap.py), sized from _note_cost; it resets if the worker restarts, so pair each with a provider budget. context_window=full resends every prior decision frame each query (history capped by max_history_tokens), so per-episode input grows quadratically with steps: estimate cost before launch.
_note_launch: Launch with difficulty_max_static_score = 8000 (--difficulty-max-static-score 8000, fleet DIFFICULTY_MAX=8000), set for this panel: the largest static score is M10's, about 7,840. Stage 2 refuses the run if any selected maze scores above the cap. Stage 2 takes tens of minutes per maze on these 18x18 mechanics mazes: the calibration scores only its own maze. Run it locally (python -m scripts.run_pipeline); the Claude client then uses the synchronous API at standard price.
_note_cache: Prompt caching on: with context_window=full and text_only, the history goes out as one text block per step (PR #75) with breakpoints on the newest step and the previous request's newest step, so each query reads the system prompt and every earlier observation and action from cache and writes only the new step; the current state, budget/stall lines and question sit after the last breakpoint. Kimi and Qwen get the same text joined into one string (implicit prefix caching). Opus: Message Batches with batch_cache_ttl=1h on the fleet. Kimi K3: prompt_cache_ttl=1h (erratic max-effort latency). See run_config.mechanics_15_2d.json's _note_cache for the image-mode measurements.
